cases.title: Vue 2 to Nuxt migration
cases.description: Leading the modernization of a legacy ERP front end toward Vue 3 and Nuxt, improving architecture, maintainability, code quality, and the development experience for the team.
outcomes: Planned a gradual Vue 2 to Vue 3 and Nuxt migration without interrupting ongoing ERP development
Evolved the front-end architecture and standardized reusable components
Improved maintainability, code quality, and the team's development experience

cases.title: Sports prediction platform
cases.description: A complete sports pool application with a Vue.js interface, Node.js back end, and a prediction service built with Python, FastAPI, and scikit-learn using recent team form and head-to-head history.
outcomes: Developed the sports pool workflows and responsive Vue.js interface
Built the Node.js back end and competition data model
Created a FastAPI and scikit-learn prediction service consumed by the application

experience.title: From implementation to integration leadership.
experience.intro: My path spans internal tools, fintech products, enterprise platforms, and the engineering decisions that help teams deliver with confidence.

items.role: Mid-level Systems Analyst I · Technical Lead, Integrations
items.summary: Progressed from Junior Developer I to Mid-level Systems Analyst I, taking on technical leadership within the integrations area and strategic ERP modernization projects.

positions.intro: As a Mid-level Full Stack Developer, I lead strategic technical projects and am responsible for evolving ERP integrations with external platforms and modernizing the system's front-end architecture.
responsibilities: Technical leadership within the systems integrations area, defining solutions, developing features, and resolving complex front-end and back-end issues.
End-to-end development of the integration between TagPlus and Mercado Livre.
Technical enablement of four developers for the integrations area, sharing knowledge about architecture, business rules, and integration workflows.
Technical leadership of the team migrating the legacy ERP from Vue 2 to Vue 3 and Nuxt 3.
Active participation in code reviews, technical guidance, and the adoption of engineering best practices.
positions.closing: This position consolidated my experience in technical leadership, full-stack development, software architecture, systems integration, and technical decision-making.

positions.intro: I expanded my technical responsibilities and began contributing to strategic company projects, including internal tools and ERP integrations with external platforms.
responsibilities: Active development and evolution of Project Feedback, an internal tool that collects and analyzes GitLab API data to produce development, productivity, and activity metrics.
Development of features and interfaces for visualizing technical indicators.
Serving as the main technical reference within the systems integrations area, responsible for its front-end and back-end functionality.
Development and maintenance of APIs, interfaces, and communication flows between the TagPlus ERP and external platforms.
Independent analysis and resolution of technical integration issues.
Continued evolution of TagPlus 2.0 using Vue.js and Nuxt.
positions.closing: This stage was an important step forward in my career, bringing greater autonomy, technical responsibility, and experience in integrations and technical decision-making.

positions.intro: I worked on the team responsible for TagPlus 2.0, a strategic project to modernize and replace the legacy ERP with a platform focused on scalability, performance, usability, and maintainability.
responsibilities: Development of new features and interfaces with Vue.js and Nuxt, translating complex ERP business rules into intuitive solutions.
Active participation in the Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 migration and the gradual replacement of the legacy system.
Creation and maintenance of reusable components and visual standards.
Development and maintenance of automated tests with Cypress.
Participation in code reviews and sharing of engineering best practices.
Implementation of features aligned with business rules and ERP customer needs.
positions.closing: This experience deepened my Vue.js expertise and broadened my understanding of front-end architecture, software quality, and enterprise application maintenance.

items.summary: Built responsive interfaces, reusable components, and business workflows for the company's internal platform in a four-person team.

positions.intro: I joined a four-developer team responsible for building and evolving the company's new internal website, using Vue.js as the primary technology.
responsibilities: Development of interactive, responsive, and dynamic interfaces focused on usability and user experience.
Creation and maintenance of custom reusable components.
Development of new features and improvement of existing ones for internal company processes.
Integration of front-end interfaces with APIs and services built by the back-end team.
Collaboration with the team to maintain visual consistency, code organization, and delivery quality.
positions.closing: Working in a lean team gave me an active role in the project and strengthened my autonomy, problem-solving skills, and experience building Vue.js applications for real business needs.

items.summary: Delivered public and internal fintech applications, from Vue/Nuxt interfaces to Node.js services and contributions to the Afro Pay mobile app.

positions.intro: I took on greater responsibility for developing, maintaining, and improving the company's web applications across both front-end and back-end development.
responsibilities: Development and improvement of the public Afro Pay platform with Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and Vuetify.
Development and maintenance of internal web applications.
Creation and maintenance of REST APIs and back-end functionality with Node.js.
End-to-end delivery of features across front-end and back-end layers.
State management with Vuex and integration with back-end services.
Use of Docker to configure and standardize development environments.
positions.closing: This stage consolidated my full-stack knowledge, autonomy, and understanding of architecture, APIs, and application maintainability.

positions.intro: I worked as a full-stack developer in a three-person team responsible for Banco Afro's web applications, including the public Afro Pay platform and internal systems.
responsibilities: Development of responsive interfaces and reusable components with Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and Vuetify.
Development and maintenance of APIs and back-end functionality with Node.js.
Implementation of features across both front-end and back-end layers.
State management and API integration using Vuex.
Use of Docker to standardize development environments.
Generation of PDF documents from HTML using Gotenberg.
positions.closing: The experience broadened my understanding of architecture, systems integration, and full-stack development.

items.summary: Developed internal corporate systems in partnership with SENAI, supporting authentication, administration, and operational workflows.

positions.intro: I contributed to internal projects developed in partnership with SENAI, building login systems and other solutions with Vue.js on the front end and PHP on the back end.
responsibilities: Implementation of internal enterprise systems and authentication features.
Development of Vue.js interfaces and PHP back-end functionality.
Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams to deliver effective, high-quality solutions.
positions.closing: This experience marked the beginning of my professional path in full-stack development and enterprise systems.
